items.title: 2.5 Python Modules and Built-in Data Structures (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Python ke saath ek bari standard library aati hai jis mein bohat se built-in (pehle se bane) modules aur data structures hain. Data structure ka matlab hai data ko organized (tarteeb se) rakhne aur store karne ki ek khaas shakal ya tareeqa; maslan list ek data structure hai jo hum pehle istemal kar chuke hain. Is hisse mein hum Python ke functions, modules aur libraries ka istemal dekhenge.

blocks.prompt: Data structure kya hai? Misal dijiye.
blocks.explanation: Data ko organized tareeqe se rakhne aur store karne ka tareeqa, ta ke usay aasani se istemal kiya ja sake, jaise list.

items: Data structure: data rakhne ka tareeqa (jaise list).
Is hisse mein functions, modules, libraries.
